items.title: Digital technologies enabling China's shift toward smart manufacturing - Xinhua
items.summary: Digital technologies enabling China's shift toward smart manufacturing-Xinhua. This is how the premium substrate glass panels roll off the cutting-edge G8.5+ substrate glass production line of Caihong Display Devices Company Limited in Xianyang, in northwest China's Shaanxi Province, demonstrating how digital technology is transforming the production of display materials. Caihong's G8.5+ substrate glass production line has broken the long-standing monopoly of overseas companies in the large-size substrate glass market, enabling China to achieve self-reliance and secure supply of high-end display materials, according to an executive of the company who preferred to be anonymous. "By integrating cutting-edge technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence into the entire production process, our technical team has begun building an integrated intelligent system covering the full chain, from R&D and design to smart manufacturing and energy management," the executive said. Caihong's smart G8.5+ substrate glass production line represents a broader trend in which China's manufacturing sector is leveraging digital intelligence to upgrade and break through technological bottlenecks.

items.title: Yujin Technology Selected for Government AI Manufacturing Platform Project - thelec.net
items.summary: * UPDATE : 2026-07-22 21:26 (Wed). Yujin Technology Selected for Government AI Manufacturing Platform Project. ## Consortium to develop generative AI platform for battery equipment manufacturing with 1.1 billion won in first-year funding. * Published 2026.07.22 21:26. Yujin Technology said on July 22 that it has been selected as the preferred bidder for the South Korean government's 2026 AI Transformation (AX) One-Stop Voucher Program, led by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the National IT Industry Promotion Agency (NIPA). Yujin Technology will carry out the project through a consortium with Plan I and Gabia, developing a generative AI-based manufacturing platform for battery equipment. The project will receive approximately 1.1 billion won in government funding during its first year. A second year of funding of a similar scale is expected following an evaluation of the first year's performance. During the first phase, Yujin Technology plans to complete development of the AI platform and conduct proof-of-concept demonstrations.
